scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns isotropic scaling of a fixed positive shape with coupling length normalized to one. It settles zero-energy contact and the two critical dilation endpoints, not arbitrary anisotropic deformation paths or the quantitative size of gaps away from criticality. Analytic proof controls the infinite Bloch family; bundled computations are corroborative only.
title: Exact isotropic-dilation window for zero-energy contact in the anisotropic hexagonal minus-R lattice
